checks.comparison_actually_executed: Full Python structure equality before condensation; not hash-only validation.

scope_and_limitations: Final rerun has 3 independent worlds and 41 declared checks: M1=13, M2=14, M4=14. All passed and not-executed count is zero.
Only M1 dynamically adds a third project. M4 contains A/B only and uses A::work-2 for executable incomplete content.
M2 same actor alice, identical payload and textual key across A/B uses explicit local B permission. Same-project retry returns the existing result without duplicate formal effects.

M4 evaluates finite top-level JSON field presence and conflicting values; it does not establish numeric, financial, or professional correctness. delivery_only has an owner-attributed accepted record rather than an external approve action.
Invalid package atomicity compares declared business facts and registered immutable/mirror files; rejected-command logging, clock and journal bookkeeping are excluded.

condensation.omitted: Only the duplicated large expected/observed business-prefix bodies in invalid_package_business_prefix_unchanged are replaced by exact canonical digests and a raw report location. Raw snapshot bodies remain in referenced files.
condensation.retained: Complete protocol, all 41 named checks with expectations/outcomes, failure and not-executed fields, source/script identities, every raw file path/SHA256/size and per-checkpoint file hashes.
condensation.canonical_hash_encoding: SHA256 of finite UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon).
